Falcons vs Packers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, September 24 · NFL Week 3 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 23, 11:36 PM ET

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection in Thursday Night Football's Falcons at Packers DraftKings Showdown slate: 19.4 DraftKings points at an $11,800 FLEX salary, or 29.0 at captain for $17,700. Bijan Robinson holds the largest share of simulated winning-lineup credit at 68% across 100,000 simulations, and Bijan Robinson holds the largest captain share at 22.5%.

Behind Robinson, the next four projections are Jordan Love (16.9, $10,000), Michael Penix Jr. (15.8, $9,000), Drake London (14.1, $8,800) and Christian Watson (12.7, $9,800). Green Bay is a 6.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 44.5, with implied team totals of 25.5 for the Packers and 19 for the Falcons.

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 23, 11:36 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bijan Robinson, ATL RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Bijan Robinson holds 22.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 19.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 13.7 carries and 5.6 targets. The current projection of 19.4 compares with a saved model baseline of 20.7. Across 100,000 simulations Robinson averaged 19.4 points with a simulated floor of 7.5 and a ceiling of 37.1. He holds 68% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 22.5% as the captain and 45.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jordan Love, GB QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jordan Love holds 12.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 16.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations Love averaged 16.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 30.5. He holds 67% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.8% as the captain and 54.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Drake London, ATL WR ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Drake London holds 12.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,200 and the 14.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 21.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 8.3 targets on 26.3 routes. The current projection of 14.1 compares with a saved model baseline of 13.4. Across 100,000 simulations London averaged 14.1 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 29.7. He holds 47% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.3% as the captain and 34.9% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Falcons vs Packers

Michael Penix Jr., ATL QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Michael Penix Jr. carries the 3rd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 15.8 DraftKings points for a $9,000 FLEX salary ($13,500 at captain). The model includes 4.2 rushing attempts. The current projection of 15.8 compares with a saved model baseline of 0.0. Across 100,000 simulations Penix averaged 15.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 28.8. He holds 61% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.4% as the captain and 52.7% in a FLEX spot.

Christian Watson, GB WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Christian Watson carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.7 DraftKings points for a $9,800 FLEX salary ($14,700 at captain). The model gives him 6.7 targets on 26.3 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Watson averaged 12.7 points with a simulated floor of 4.3 and a ceiling of 26.4. He holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.3% as the captain and 32.2% in a FLEX spot.

MarShawn Lloyd, GB RB ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

MarShawn Lloyd carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.5 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 11.2 carries and 1.7 targets. The current projection of 11.5 compares with a saved model baseline of 12.6. Across 100,000 simulations Lloyd averaged 11.5 points with a simulated floor of 1.7 and a ceiling of 27.3. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.5% as the captain and 24.4% in a FLEX spot.

Trey Smack, GB K ($5,200 FLEX / $7,800 CPT)

Trey Smack carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.9 DraftKings points for a $5,200 FLEX salary ($7,800 at captain). Across 100,000 simulations Smack averaged 10.0 points with a simulated floor of 3.5 and a ceiling of 19.4. He holds 38% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.2% as the captain and 34.7% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Olamide Zaccheaus, ATL WR ($2,000 FLEX / $3,000 CPT)

Olamide Zaccheaus projects for 4.6 DraftKings points at a $2,000 FLEX salary, 2.31 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.9 targets on 13.6 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Zaccheaus averaged 4.6 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 14.3. He holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.7% as the captain and 12.0% in a FLEX spot.

Skyy Moore projects for 4.5 DraftKings points at a $2,400 FLEX salary, 1.85 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.4 targets on 16.7 routes. The current projection of 4.5 compares with a saved model baseline of 1.9. Across 100,000 simulations Moore averaged 4.5 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 14.9. He holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.8% as the captain and 12.1% in a FLEX spot.
